title: ASSORTED WORLD STAMPS & RELATE...
identification: Mixed world stamp lot: three or so PRC stock books (J and T series, late 1970s-80s, mostly pictorial sets, mint or CTO unknown), two old-time albums of Australia Commonwealth and Australian States (used, QV-era), and a small box of bundles. Notes suggested T.44 Huangshan 1979 but T.44 (1980) is Qi Baishi paintings; the Huangshan landscapes set is S57 (1963), a different and valuable issue, so the grey-green landscapes in the book are probably a later 1979-80s scenery set and not S57. Most 1980s PRC sets are common and cheap.
